
```{r libraries}
# devtools::install("../fridge") #run this in console
library(fridge)
library(ggelato)
library(fabletools)
library(feasts)
library(tsibble)
library(dplyr)
```

## Data

Australian Domestic Tourism data in `tsibble` package is used in this example. First, we need to aggregate the data by its hierarchical structure `(State/Region)*Purpose` using `fabletools::aggregate_key()`. This means that `Region` is nested within `State` and `Purpose` has crossed relationships with both of `State` and `Region`.

```{r data}
tourism_hts <- tourism |>
  aggregate_key((State / Region) * Purpose, Trips = sum(Trips))
```

## Time series features plot

```{r hts features}
tourism_ft <- tourism_hts |>
  features(Trips, feature_set(pkgs = "feasts"))

tourism_feasts <- gig(tourism_ft,
    gig_aes(x = trend_strength, 
            y = seasonal_strength_year),
    structure = (State/Region)*Purpose) +
  geom_features()

tourism_feasts
```

## STL decomposition plot

```{r reuse-2}
stl_original <- tourism_hts |>
  model(stl = STL(Trips)) |>
  components() |>
  as_data_frame()

stl_scaled <- tourism_hts |>
  group_by_key() |>
  mutate(Trips = as.numeric(scale(Trips))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  model(stl = STL(Trips)) |>
  components() |>
  as_tibble()

tourism_stl <- gig(
  stl_original,
  gig_aes(
    x = Quarter,
    y = Trips,
    seasonality = season_year,
    trend = trend,
    remainder = remainder
  ),
  structure = (State / Region) * Purpose
) +
  geom_stl(scaled = stl_scaled)

tourism_stl
```

## Sunburst

```{r sunburst}
tourism_sunburst <- gig(as_tibble(tourism_hts), 
    structure = (State/Region)*Purpose) +
  geom_sunburst(labels = TRUE) 

tourism_sunburst
```

## Coordinating multiple plots with `fridge()` in `fridge` `R` package

:::{.column-screen}
```{r}
fridge(tourism_stl,
       tourism_feasts, 
       tourism_sunburst, 
       fullscreen = FALSE) 
```

:::
